title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ow6z: Fragment::from_bytes signature changed but 6 test call sites still pass tile buffer
description: Commit 344c8fa removed the tile buffer parameter from Fragment::from_bytes (now takes only data: &[u8]) and updated the fuzz target, but missed 6 call sites in tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs (lines 214, 241, 379) and tests/fragmentation.rs (lines 123, 125, 236) that still pass &mut tile as second argument. cargo test -p lichen-schc fails with E0061.
